rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when institute means to begin an activity, process, or undertaking.

example.english: We will institute this project next month.
example.traditional: 我哋下個月開始做呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 zou6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when institute means to put a policy, system, or practice into operation.

example.english: The company will institute a new overtime system next month.
example.traditional: 公司下個月會推行新嘅加班制度。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 teoi1 haang4 san1 ge3 gaa1 baan1 zai3 dou6

rows.note: Use this when institute means to establish or found an organization, institution, or company.

example.english: A few of us friends got together to institute a social enterprise.
example.traditional: 我哋幾個朋友一齊成立咗一間社企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gei2 go3 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 sing4 lap6 zo2 jat1 gaan1 se5 kei5

rows.note: Use 機構 as the all-purpose term for an organization founded to promote a cause.

example.english: This institute is dedicated to defending the rights of low-income families.
example.traditional: 呢個機構專門幫基層家庭爭取權益。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gei1 kau3 zyun1 mun4 bong1 gei1 cang4 gaa1 ting4 zang1 ceoi2 kyun4 jik1

rows.note: Use 研究所 specifically for an institute devoted to research, especially scientific or medical research.

example.english: This institute is currently developing a new medicine.
example.traditional: 呢間研究所最近研發緊新藥。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 jin4 gau3 so2 zeoi3 gan6 jin4 faat3 gan2 san1 joek6

rows.note: Use 學院 for an educational institute or college, particularly one teaching a technical or specialized subject.

example.english: My cousin studies hotel management at that institute.
example.traditional: 我表弟喺嗰間學院讀酒店管理。
example.jyutping: ngo5 biu2 dai6 hai2 go2 gaan1 hok6 jyun2 duk6 zau2 dim3 gun2 lei5

rows.note: Use 校舍 when the institute building is specifically an educational institution's premises.

example.english: After the institute moved, its old school building has been unused ever since.
example.traditional: 學院搬咗之後，舊校舍就一直冇人用。
example.jyutping: hok6 jyun2 bun1 zo2 zi1 hau6 gau6 haau6 se3 zau6 jat1 zik6 mou5 jan4 jung6
